title: The Sealing Trade
setup: Both kings are tucked behind their pawns, and the rooks face each other down the b-file. Whoever strikes first lives.
hint: Before you call a capture a trade, work out which black piece could take back.
explanation:
## The Idea

Black's king on g8 has no square of its own: f7, g7 and h7 hold its pawns, and f8 and h8 lie on the eighth rank.

So the rook on b8 is not a trading partner. It is the only guard of that rank, and {{Rxb8#}} takes it and mates at once: the king cannot reach b8, and pawns do not move backward.

Before trading the last rook off an open file, ask what it was doing besides standing there.
